description.value: Kokomo is a plant-based cafe and eatery in Kitsilano serving freshly made bowls, salads, acai bowls, and smoothies with an entirely vegan menu. It is one of four Metro Vancouver locations operated by Kokomo Foods Inc., offering both indoor and outdoor seating. The kitchen focuses on whole-food, globally inspired dishes — from lemongrass noodle salad to shawarma macro bowls — making it a solid refuelling stop for cyclists.

The website confirms an entirely plant-based menu (bowls, salads, acai, smoothies) and online ordering ('Order Now' links), supporting takeout and vegan/vegetarian claims; no website evidence addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established plant-based cafe with indoor and outdoor seating in a cycling-friendly Kitsilano neighbourhood; an appealing and cyclist-relevant food stop with confirmed takeout options.
